title: School: First Period
summary: Scene 4. Their first lesson: local studies, where the four founders are named, or Hulda Brack's workshop induction. Each player picks a room.
goal: Each player has sat a lesson of their choice, and the table has heard the four founders' names.
howToPlay: Short and light. Each player picks a room; cut between the two. Not rolling is always fine. **The founders' names come out here, however the rolls go.**

intro.where: The school block, first floor: two rooms at opposite ends of one corridor.
intro.readAloud: A bell goes, and the corridor fills in about four seconds. At one end, a man is pulling a city map down over the blackboard. At the other, somebody is already shouting about fingers.
intro.landmark: The corridor between the two doors.

carriesIn.then: Vetch has left them at the corridor with a timetable.

position.note: The first-floor corridor of the school block.

cast.role: Teaches history, and local studies, which he loves.

brief.wants: For them to find their way round the city by the end of the week.
brief.opensWith: "Where do you think you are right now? Show me." The map is already down.

willDiscuss.note: "Ota. Mister Ota, if you like. Ota if you don't."
Districts, trams, where to eat, and which streets to avoid after dark. "The number 4 is always late. Plan around it."
Proud of them and cheerfully certain: four tall heroes, every picture shows it.
"A gnoll, with HYUCK on the plaque? Somebody's mascot. Hyuck was a big man with a sword."

willNotDiscuss.why: He doesn't know, and it doesn't bother him: "Mascots get names. Right, trams."

voice.register: Unhurried and dry. Taps the map. Says "I don't know" plainly and doesn't mind.
samples: "You are here. No. You are here, which is a mile from where you said, and that mile is all steps."

cast.role: Head of the machine shop, taking the safety induction herself.

brief.wants: Everyone leaving her workshop with the same number of fingers they came in with.
brief.opensWith: "In. Sit. Hands where I can see them, all of you."

willDiscuss.note: Exactly how each one would hurt them, at length, with relish.
A nuar, and proud of it. She won't wear a glamour for anyone.
"Off a Frame. It'll be back on by Thursday. Not cleared. Not today."

willNotDiscuss.why: They're not cleared for her floor yet: "Earn it. Then ask me again."

voice.register: Enormous and warm. Calls people by the machine they're standing next to. Ends a point by hitting metal.
samples: "You, by the lathe. What does that do? Wrong, and thank you for being wrong out loud."
"No, you're useless. Good. Useless I can work with. It's the handy ones that end up in hospital."

brief.statblock: Proposed: level 4, a machine-shop chief, can fight if she has to.

beats.text: Each player picks a room: local studies or the workshop. Splitting up is fine.

choicePoint.label: First period. Which end of the corridor?

options.label: Local studies: the city on a wall map.
options.blurb: Learn where everything is and how to get there.
options.consequence: Where everything is, how to get there, and who founded the place.

options.label: Workshop induction: the machine shop.
options.consequence: Tools, hands, and a very loud woman with horns.

beats.text: In local studies, the teacher asks the room to name the four founders. Offer the check; on any result the table hears them.
beats.note:
Do: The four are Hyuck, Rupiah, Anabala and Shucks Mordant: "who you'll have met this morning. Don't stare, he hates it."
If nobody chose local studies: The four names are on the corridor noticeboard: "Learn these for Friday."
Watch for: Four of your players played these four. Let them enjoy hearing the names.

beats.text: The teacher takes them round the city on the wall map. If anyone works at it, offer the check.
beats.note:
Plant: The harbour statue: a weathered gnoll with HYUCK on the plaque. He's sure it's a mascot.
Secret: The statue is Hyuck as he was. He's alive, and test-pilots the Directorate's worst Frames.
Watch for: Steve played Hyuck. Let the mascot joke land on him.

beats.text: Hulda Brack runs the safety induction. If anyone joins in, offer the check.
beats.note: Plant: Four metres of Frame forearm on trestles at the back, opened along one side, fingers curled. She won't let them near it.

beats.text: The bell. Give them about thirty seconds in the corridor to compare notes, then send them to the stores.

artefacts.title: The history teacher's tram map
artefacts.earnedBy: A critical success in local studies.
artefacts.gmNote: +1 circumstance to finding their way round the city.
artefacts.body: A city tram map, soft with use and covered in pencil: times, cafés worth the walk, a circled stop, and the 4 is never on time underlined twice.

outro.endsWhen: The bell, and the corridor empties toward the stores.

transition.line: The timetable says the stores next, and the queue starts before the bell.

outro.onwards: Kit Issue, at the quartermaster's stores.
writeDown: Who sat which room, and what they rolled.
Anyone kept back, and anyone Fatigued tonight.

temptations.text: There's a four-metre hand on the trestles at the back, and she's just told them not to go near it.

reactionPrompts.text: The founders' names landing with the table.
Both rooms getting time, cut between briskly.

notes: Not rolling is free; rewards and costs are never announced. What the rooms pay: local studies gives the founders' names (always), a way round the city this afternoon, and on a critical success the teacher's tram map; the workshop gives +2 tonight on working the drain chamber's panels, applied without comment. A critical failure in either keeps a character back and sends them into tonight's job Fatigued; a failure in local studies makes them last into the stores, where the handlamps have run out.
